name: Insurance Claims Assistant
description: Claims, fraud, and underwriting vocabulary + starter questions. Built on the IBM insurance use-case pattern: claims processing, fraud detection, and underwriting are the highest-value, most-mature AI use cases in insurance.
starter_prompts: Summarize open claims by adjuster and days-to-settle for this quarter
Which claims have risk factors that suggest possible fraud?
What is our claims volume trend by product line over the last 6 months?

terminology.description: A formal request for coverage payment. Distinguish from 'policy' (the contract) and 'coverage' (the scope of protection).
The process of evaluating applicant risk to decide whether to offer coverage and at what price.
Incurred losses divided by earned premiums — the core profitability ratio of a book of business.
The agreed payout that closes a claim. A settled claim is closed; a pending claim is still open.
Net Promoter Score — customer loyalty metric. Gen-AI-assisted insurers see materially higher NPS (IBM IBV).
A data pattern (duplicate claims, identity mismatches, unusual timing) that flags a claim for investigation — never an automatic denial.
